preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the length of the paths k are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of colors needed is at least 2.
The coloring array contains exactly (n * (n - 1)) / 2 elements, representing all possible edges in the graph.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in coloring)
postconditions.description: Each edge in the graph is colored with a number between 1 and c.

postconditions.expression: all(coloring[i] != coloring[j] for i in range(len(coloring)) for j in range(i + 1, len(coloring)) if (i // (n - 1)) == (j // (n - 1)) and i % (n - 1) < j % (n - 1))
postconditions.description: No two edges that are part of the same row (i.e., edges with the same start node) have the same color.

postconditions.expression: all(coloring[i] != coloring[j] for i in range(len(coloring)) for j in range(i + 1, len(coloring)) if (i % (n - 1)) == (j % (n - 1)) and i // (n - 1) < j // (n - 1))
postconditions.description: No two edges that are part of the same column (i.e., edges with the same end node) have the same color.

postconditions.expression: all(coloring[i] != coloring[j] for i in range(len(coloring)) for j in range(i + 1, len(coloring)) if (i // (n - 1)) < (j // (n - 1)) and (i % (n - 1)) < (j % (n - 1)))
postconditions.description: No two edges that are part of the same diagonal (i.e., edges where the start node is less than the end node) have the same color.

postconditions.expression: all(coloring[i] != coloring[j] for i in range(len(coloring)) for j in range(i + 1, len(coloring)) if (i // (n - 1)) > (j // (n - 1)) and (i % (n - 1)) > (j % (n - 1)))
postconditions.description: No two edges that are part of the opposite diagonal (i.e., edges where the start node is greater than the end node) have the same color.
